mapper.insert: INSERT INTO encrypted_record (table_name, record_id, cipher_blob, integrity_tag, key_version) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{recordId}, #{cipherBlob}, #{integrityTag}, #{keyVersion})
INSERT INTO encrypted_index (table_name, column_name, record_id, rindex, skindex, segment_id) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{columnName}, #{recordId}, #{rindex}, #{skindex}, #{segmentId})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT table_name AS tableName, column_name AS columnName FROM encrypted_index ORDER BY table_name ASC, column_name ASC

SELECT id, table_name AS tableName, record_id AS recordId, cipher_blob AS cipherBlob, integrity_tag AS integrityTag, key_version AS keyVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM encrypted_record WHERE table_name = #{table} AND record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, table_name AS tableName, record_id AS recordId, cipher_blob AS cipherBlob, integrity_tag AS integrityTag, key_version AS keyVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM encrypted_record ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, table_name AS tableName, column_name AS columnName, record_id AS recordId, rindex, skindex, segment_id AS segmentId FROM encrypted_index WHERE table_name = #{table} AND column_name = #{column} ORDER BY rindex ASC, id ASC

SELECT r.record_id, r.cipher_blob, r.integrity_tag, r.key_version, i.table_name, i.column_name, i.rindex, i.segment_id FROM encrypted_index i INNER JOIN encrypted_record r ON i.record_id = r.record_id WHERE i.table_name = #{table} AND i.column_name = #{column} AND i.rindex BETWEEN #{lower} AND #{upper} ORDER BY i.rindex ASC

SELECT r.record_id, r.cipher_blob, r.integrity_tag, r.key_version, i.table_name, i.column_name, i.rindex, i.segment_id FROM encrypted_record r LEFT JOIN encrypted_index i ON i.record_id = r.record_id AND i.table_name = r.table_name AND i.column_name = #{column} WHERE r.table_name = #{table} AND r.record_id IN
#{recordId}

SELECT r.record_id, r.cipher_blob, r.integrity_tag, r.key_version, r.created_at, i.table_name, i.column_name, i.rindex, i.segment_id FROM encrypted_record r LEFT JOIN encrypted_index i ON i.record_id = r.record_id AND i.table_name = r.table_name AND i.column_name = #{column} WHERE r.table_name = #{table} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
